page_line.definition: today's trailing volatility times the 5 percent quantile of past ten-day returns each divided by the volatility at their own start

the_two_lines_on_the_book.reading: on the reconstructed book the UNCONDITIONAL line fails coverage and the scaled line passes; on the published factor it was the other way round, so the over-breach was a property of that series and not of the estimator

shuffle_control.reading: shuffled, the forecast is WORSE than the unconditional quantile it is compared against; the gain is the volatility series knowing something about the date it scales, not the transformation

fitted_regression_tie.reading: the fitted quantile regression and the parameter-free line cannot be told apart on loss, so the simplification is vindicated on parsimony and not on performance

conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.name: bear state (Daniel-Moskowitz)
conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.verdict: refuted: the interval excludes one on the wrong side, it makes the forecast worse

conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.name: calendar state (FOMC and earnings-heavy days)
conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.verdict: no improvement: the interval contains one
conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.caveat: effectively FOMC-only here; on at 22 of 81 formations, 18 from FOMC and 4 from earnings, median earnings weight in window 0.29 percent against a 10 percent threshold, because the 8-K corpus covers 1,579 of about 2,900 tickers and begins in 2018

conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.name: volatility tercile
conditioning_variables_tested_and_not_us.verdict: no improvement: the interval contains one

concentration_per_leg.weighting: value-weighted within each leg, market value from quantity times price
